description: Hosted apps with a dev and a main branch, shipped as container images: routine updates on dev, only security fixes on main.

packageRules.description: main only gets security fixes: vulnerabilityAlerts forces them through this rule, as pull requests
Node in .nvmrc and in the Dockerfile base images moves as one update. Schedule and automerge follow the update type (patch, minor, major) as in the shared preset.
New digests of the node image (same tag, e.g. an Alpine fix) on their own branch, so a waiting minor or major pull request does not hold them back.
